item.title: Chronic Enteropathy Associated With SLCO2A1 Gene Mutation; Initially Misdiagnosed as Fibrostenosing Crohn's Disease.
item.description: ACG case reports journal - Case report - Chronic enteropathy associated with SLCO2A1 (CEAS) is a rare condition that can mimic fibrostenosing Crohn's disease. We describe a young man with presumed Crohn's disease marked by recurrent bowel...
